items.source: Exception thrown when during the execution of a DbAction an exception gets thrown. Provides additional context information about the action and the entity.
items.translation: 在执行 DbAction 期间抛出异常时，会抛出此异常。它提供了有关该操作和实体的额外上下文信息。

items.source: action - the DbAction which triggered the exception. Must not be null.
items.translation: action - 触发该异常的DbAction接口。不能为null。

items.source: cause - the underlying exception. May not be null.
